Silver Scholarship Programs for Indian Students to Study Abroad – 2022

Are you a student still undergoing graduation? Are you also someone who aspires to study abroad? Do you wish to have an admission opportunity to study in an Ivy League College before you get your Undergrad degree in your hands? Well, apparently some wild wishes do come true! You might not believe it, but there is a way of getting admission to Yale University for an MBA before you finish your bachelor’s. Let us tell you how.

Yale Silver Scholars Program

Yale Silver Scholars Program is a magical opportunity that paves way for a college senior to study for an MBA degree and begin a career in the booming industries of his choice.

    Initiation and applicability

    Silver Scholars is a 3-year early admission program open to college seniors all across the globe. It aims to create a holistic environment enabling candidates hailing from different educational backgrounds to share their skills, talent, and knowledge.

    The best thing about the program is that it is a contrast to the traditional style of Master’s Programs that rely on previous work experience for admitting students into the university as well as for providing job placements.

    Although, the program admits only 5% of students in comparison to the rates of a traditional MBA course admission at Yale University.

    Additionally, Yale Silver Scholars Program is the only one that provides an offer for an internship while you are still studying for a master’s degree.

      Skills and other requirements

      The program does not require a yet-to-be undergraduate student to have any work experience but looks for other crucial skills such as:

      Extraordinariness in college senior

      Enthusiasm in learning

        Maturity in handling obstacles

        Active participation in co-curricular activities

        Short term internships

        Decent GMAT/GRE Score

          A strong story conveyed through resume and interview (if selected)

          [content_block id=14313 slug=zoho-form]

            Eligibility Criteria

            A student is supposed to apply through the full-time MBA Program admission route itself, but for availing of the silver scholar’s program he/she has to take care of the following points:

            You are only eligible to apply if you are in the third year of your undergraduate course.

              You must provide two letters of recommendation: one from an academic instructor/ faculty member for your performance  and

              Another from an employer (in case of part-time job/ internship) or an organization where you actively volunteered in/ performed any extra-curricular activity.

              Application form

              Things to include in your application:

                Official transcripts of your undergraduate course-two certified copies

                Copies of previously secured degrees, if any.

                Curriculum Vitae

                GMAT/GRE Score

                TOEFL/IELTS Results

                Two letters of recommendations

                  One creatively drafted main essay

                  For guidance on the application filing process and help in drafting the essay, reach out to one of our experts at (hyperlink)

                  Selection Process

                  Best applications are picked after a thorough analysis of the candidate’s profile. The selected candidates are called for an interview which can be in-person or through video-calling means as chosen by the applicant.

                  The interview majorly focuses on the ambitions, interests, and skills of the candidate.

                  Selected candidates receive an offer letter from the Yale University Office.

                    Yale Silver Scholars Program- Structure

                    The program admits you to a 3 year MBA course. We have compiled the details separately for each year, mentioned below:

                    Year One

                    The candidates in the first year of the program share the classroom with fellow undergraduates coming from different educational as well as cultural backgrounds.

                    They are introduced to a very unconventional study syllabus and are encouraged to develop efficient management skills.

                    They are offered to learn a palette of core courses from prominent faculties.

                    These courses are:

                    Introduction to Negotiation

                    Power and Politics

                    Managing Groups and Teams

                    Global Virtual Teams

                    Basics of Accounting

                      Modeling Managerial Decisions

                      Probability Modelling and Statistics

                      Basics of Economics

                      Year Two

                      With the theoretical knowledge gained in the first year of the program, candidates are offered a full-time internship where they apply the same to practice real-life scenarios. This helps them shape their skills to secure a successful career in the future. These internships are provided at various reputed organizations, some of which are Pfizer, Boston Consultancy Group, Coca Cola,

                      Motorola and CARE.

                      Year Three

                      Post the second-year internship, the third-year MBA program commences wherein the students choose their electives at Yale as well as other global universities for Advanced Management in areas that complement the career path they have chosen so far.

                      All students must meet at least one of the following Global Studies Requirements which are:

                      Taking a course in International Experience, by spending ten days in a location situated overseas to understand the global economy

                        a mini-course for Advanced Management hosted by one of the member schools in the Global Network

                        Completing an online GNC (Global Network Course) a virtual course to look at a cross-national business problem in which students work with a global team

                        Selecting other approved electives that involve international travel and study

                          Access to career advisors and their guidance in the building profession

                          Opportunity to network with talented people
